title: Calculate a value from state
summary: A computed value is based on other reactive values.
introduction: A computed value is based on other reactive values. Your task: Change the pages-per-book number from 10 to 12.
learningObjectives: Change the pages-per-book number from 10 to 12.

blocks.text: A computed value is based on other reactive values. Vue can update it when the values it reads change.
Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `computed` keeps a calculated result connected to the reactive values its getter reads.
`ref` wraps a reactive Vue value. Script code uses `.value`; the template unwraps it for you.

blocks.text: The page starts at 30 pages. Adding a book changes it to 40.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A computed getter should calculate a result, not change unrelated state.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the pages-per-book number from 10 to 12.
